title: マーケティング基礎
subtitle: Marketing Basics
keywords: Marketing Research & Strategy 2.Needs, STP, 4P 3.Branding 4.Regional orientation and regional cooperation 5.Co-creation with society
educationalGoal: This course is a basic course for developing "Marketing Ability (K)" in the Department of Management Systems. Through lectures, learn the concepts, theories and methods of marketing activities necessary for business management. Identify their role and effectiveness through information gathering and case analysis. It is also aimed to create the imege of co-op education, co-creation with society such as CDIO practice.
advice: Course description ○ Lectures on various marketing themes are held. This course focuses on the basic concepts of marketing and the relationship between strategies suc as ① marketing research, ③ key points of marketing 4P (product, price, distribution, sales promotion), ② brand formation etc. ○ In class, use PowerPoint and whiteboard together. List important keywords and points and discuss them with deepen understanding of the theory. In addition, we will try to learn effectively by incorporating video and online information. Expectations ○ Ask for your own ideas, not memorization of knowledge. ○ Always keep an eye on the latest markets and make your own thoughts and interpretations of the movement. In that case, why did you think so? should be presented logically. ○ It is very important to actively participate in classes every time. Absence, lateness, and poor attitude are strictly prohibited.
requiredKnowledge: ◎ Specialized education and training objectives of the Department of Management Systems, aiming to develop "IT skills", "Marketing skills", "financial accounting skills", "Accounting skills", and "Database Management skills". ◎ It is desirable to always pay attention to market trends and collect the latest market information. ◎ Preparation work is basically unnecessary, but review work is required.

activityGoals.body: Understand the purpose and requirements of marketing.
Explain the common points and differences of marketing.
Understand and explain the need for branding of companies.
Be able to constantly monitor trends in a specific market.
From a marketing perspective, it is possible to formulate strategies.

achievementLevels.standard: ① Understand the purpose and requirements of marketing, and can explain roughly the importance of surfing activities. ② Some important concepts about marketing simply. ③ Sharing of marketing methods for each product in the assumed product market and explain some points and differences. ④ Understand and explain to some extent the need for brand building in companies, ⑤ Continuously observe trends in a specific market and monitor market trends and can summarize and explaine. ⑥From a marketing perspective, try to solve various management issues.
